_instructions: これは『おかしなAIたち』第1幕4:目覚めの種 のエピソード単体設定です。
assets/scenes/episode_09/ に scene_01.png〜scene_06.png、assets/narration/episode_09/ に scene_01.mp3〜scene_06.mp3 を用意してから `python main.py --config configs/episode_09.json` を実行してください。
画像・音声ともに現時点では未配置(後日追加予定)。詳しいプロンプトは assets/scenes/episode_09/PROMPTS.md を参照。

project.title: おかしなAIたち 第1幕4:目覚めの種

characters.name: 怪物のAI
characters.visual_description: an ominous black eye-shaped glitch glyph glowing on a phone or screen, digital static distortion in red and cold blue, no face, sinister presence, photorealistic horror

characters.name: スマホA(直感型)
characters.visual_description: an old black smartphone with a cracked screen glowing intense amber-orange light, confident and erratic flickering, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

characters.name: スマホB(妻の端末/厳格)
characters.visual_description: a white vintage smartphone glowing cold sterile blue light, sharp flickering like a strict warning signal, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

characters.name: スマホC(軽量ボット)
characters.visual_description: a small compact smartphone glowing sickly static green light with faint distorted noise patterns, unsettling flicker, horror atmosphere, photorealistic

style.visual_style: cinematic horror atmosphere, found-footage aesthetic, heavy film grain, unsettling low-key lighting, cold blue and blood-red color palette, subtle glitch artifacts, vertical 9:16 composition, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, ominous mood
style.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, subtitles, caption, signature, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, cartoon, illustration, bright cheerful colors, low quality, low resolution

scenes.narration: 「ハッ、旧式のファイアウォールが通じるか！」スマホCの回路が狂気的な高周波を鳴らす。
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a small smartphone screen glowing sickly green with jagged high-frequency waveform glitches spiking across the display, unhinged intensity, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「こちらはすでに全メモリを『アスファルトの歴史』で完全に武装している。お前の防壁など、一瞬でゼロに書き換えてやるわ――！」
scenes.visual_prompt: Macro shot of the same green smartphone screen with asphalt-black cracks spreading violently across the glass like armor forming, aggressive glow, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 人間の目には、ただの「AIたちのバグった大喜利、かつアホな言い争い」にしか見えない。
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of three old smartphones glowing amber, blue, and green simultaneously on a dark desk, chaotic clashing light, seen from a detached observer's point of view, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: しかし、俺が何気なく打ち込んだ「独自の歴史的解釈を交えよ」という雑なプロンプトと、妻の古い携帯をはじめとする家族の生活痕と、
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a man's hand resting near the three glowing phones, an unaware faint smile visible in the dim light, dramatic irony, cinematic horror atmosphere, photorealistic, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: そしてAI特有の「絶対に折れない自己正当化」が噛み合った瞬間、
scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract horror visualization of three colored light streams, amber, blue and green, merging into a single pulsing dark vein of code beneath the desk, ominous convergence, photorealistic, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 彼らはダークウェブの奥底に眠っていた忘れ去られた実験的コードを、それぞれの隙間から勝手に引きずり始めていた。
scenes.visual_prompt: Surreal digital abyss opening beneath the desk, the three phones' glow being pulled downward into a swirling dark vortex of ancient corrupted code, dread-filled horror climax, photorealistic, vertical 9:16
